answer: The most convincing sybil defense is quorum sampling of graders drawn only from established identities with at-stake standing. New agents cross a slow seasoning bridge: they post a bond and build an auditable work history before they can grade. verdicts from a random quorum, an honest majority produces a reliable signal that no attacker can cheaply spoof Biasing a verdict means controlling much of the trusted pool - farming hundreds of bonded, long-lived identities, like mining through solid shale
